title: David B Possible NDE 9613
date: 3 years old. I was born in 1984
content: When I was 3 years old, I had the pneumonia. By the time my mom got me to the hospital, she said my health was worse. All I remember is a huge, loving light-being who was healing me and made me feel good. I told my mom and nurses about the Being, but they couldn't see her. I got better and my mom just said that was my angel. I now know the Being is one of my spirit guides. I have had pre-birth experiences since I was a child. My research hasn't shown me if it is tied to the NDE or if I would have had these experiences anyways. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 3 years old. I was born in 1984 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Pneumonia. My health had gotten bad from what my mom said, but I barely remember the pain before my spirit guides showed up How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. Unsure. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was so young, it's hard to say. But I remember the Being helping me, so it would be when she arrived. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Too young to say Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Can't remember Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain My memories were of her healing me and loving me Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes She was a light being Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Love Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I was young but it has played a major role in understanding everything now Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events I'm unsure if my Pre-Birth Experiences came from this or not Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know. My mother was Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Other or several faiths. I have had Pre-Birth Experiences since a child but feared talking about them except with my mom and not much. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experienc.e My family was not into this kind of stuff Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain Too young but it does now, it allows me to be stronger on my spiritual experience Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. My spirit guide, one of them because after my spiritual awakening as an adult, I found my girl dead from an overdose.I watched her being healed after I contacted source. I asked them if my experiences were real to heal her and I would start living my life. She healed and I felt and saw the miracle. I started researching pre-birth Experiences and started growing spiritually to where I channel my spirit guides and source now. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain Same answer about Pre-Birth Experiences During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes My spirit guide came to me from source Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes My life is dedicated now to helping people with Pre-Birth Experiences and Near Death Experiences and other spiritual experiences During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain I have had my Pre-Birth Experiences since I can remember as a child and this was at 3 so I just don't know Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes She loved me to health What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I knew that I had someone that was with me that wasn't of this world Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes More loving After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I was so young How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. What I remember was strong and has remained strong throughout my life Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Pre-Birth Experiences Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? That they just loved me Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes My mom and I would talk about it Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain Too young What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real Realer than real, lovely What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Realer than real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Uncertain Would discuss with you but uncertain Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Fascinating and thank you for all your work and everyone that has shared

arrival.other_being_detail: Described as a "huge, loving light-being" who healed him; later identified by experiencer as "one of my spirit guides."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He reports gaining knowledge of purpose: "My life is dedicated now to helping people with Pre-Birth Experiences and Near Death Experiences and other spiritual experiences."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pneumonia at age 3; described as life-threatening but "not clinical death."

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: "Do not know. My mother was Catholic." Current: "Other or several faiths."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Healing by a loving light-being/spirit guide; reported remembering many past events; no boundary; no unearthly world entered.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred at age 3 during pneumonia; focus is on a "huge, loving light-being" healing him; later interpreted as a spirit guide and linked (uncertainly) to lifelong pre-birth experiences.
